summary: AI OS transforming courts, accelerating justice

founders.name: Utkarsh Saxena
founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.bio: CEO of Adalat AI — AI infrastructure for India’s courts, live in 25% of India’s courtrooms in 11 states, with statewide mandates in 3 states. Former Supreme Court of India law clerk and economist to Chief Economist of India; lead petitioner in India’s marriage equality case; argued landmark cases and won a $350M arbitration award. LLM (Harvard Law School), MPA/ID (Harvard Kennedy School), PhD (Oxford)

founders.name: Arghya Bhattacharya
founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.bio: CTO and co-founder of Adalat AI, building AI infrastructure for India’s courts, live in 25% of courtrooms across 11 states. First engineer at Enterpret, building ML systems used by Notion, Canva, Linear, Strava, Loom, and Monday.com. Previously led ML engineering at Equal. Published NLP/legal AI/Indic speech researcher at CoNLL, ACL workshops, NLLP, and Interspeech. MS + BTech, IIIT Hyderabad.
